reason: The P3-12 identity registry and taxonomy were merged without an explicit post-HOLD CIO approval, and their independent identity sources lack source typing, validated authority domains, exact content hashes, and observed_at/available_at binding.

records.reason: Ratified P3-12 Upbit PAPER universe record (paper_eligible_count=8: BTC, ETH, LINK, SHIB, SOL, SUI, WLD, XRP) built from an identity registry/taxonomy merged without an explicit post-HOLD CIO approval.

The 55-row canonical mapping this file's `mappings` field declares -- identified by the content hash of that field alone, independent of the document's own `approval_status`/`previous_approval_status` metadata -- has zero rows with a first-party-bound authority source (see docs/p3_12_gov_03_identity_authority_audit_and_freeze_20260830.md). This tuple stays frozen even if `approval_status` is later edited back to RATIFIED without a genuinely re-hardened `mappings` payload.

The taxonomy `records` content -- identified by its own content hash, independent of `approval_status` -- includes the KRW-LIT record, which conflates Upbit's actual listing (Lighter, a zk-rollup perps DEX) with an unrelated project (Litentry/Heima) that the record's own citation describes. This tuple stays frozen even if `approval_status` is later edited back to RATIFIED without a genuinely corrected `records` payload.
